title: A policy exploration reset helped a robot controller adapt in simulation
summary: In 30 simulation seeds, restoring an exploration parameter helped pretrained PPO controllers adapt to a reaching task after a robot joint was locked. A physical deployment also favored the reset condition for the single simulation-selected policy tested per method.
ai_technology: Proximal Policy Optimization with Gaussian policies
organization: Politecnico di Torino; Istituto Italiano di Tecnologia

source_review.scope: §§3 and 4.3, Figure 6, Table 1 and hardware sampling protocol

evidence.tested: The simulation compared continued training with a one-time exploration reset and different entropy penalties. Each physical policy was tested against the same 50 target points.
evidence.unknown: The physical experiment used a single simulation-selected seed per method and consecutive target points. The result is specific to the studied Gaussian policy parameterization and adaptation task.
evidence.ai_role: PPO-trained policies were tested with an intervention on their exploration distribution, showing a change in adaptation after the simulated task shifted.
